items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: He was the drummer that played the night we played with Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: There was a one drummer I'm going to tell you about. You have to add that in. I can't think of his name now. He was the drummer -- a real tall fella. He was the drummer that played the night we played with Benny Goodman. you understand that (inaudible). Benny asked us to change bandstands if he came up to play against us, you know. Because that was the Benny Goodman (inaudible), you know.
